summary: Verified mobile bottom nav fix on AdminLayout. On iPhone viewport (375x667) all 12 nav items render in a horizontally scrollable row (scrollWidth=841 > clientWidth=375, overflow-x=auto, .no-scrollbar applied). Each item width is between 64-89px (meets >=64px requirement). Scrolling reveals Coaching, Coaches, COAs, Customers, Settings; tapping Coaches navigates to /admin/coaches and renders the COACHES heading with the 'Add a new coach' form card. On desktop (1440x900) the mobile bottom nav has display:none (hidden by lg:hidden) and the aside sidebar shows all 12 items pointing to correct routes.
critical_code_review_comments: Mobile bottom nav could benefit from a subtle right-edge fade/gradient hint to indicate the row is scrollable, since the scrollbar is intentionally hidden (users may not realize more icons exist). Minor UX polish, not blocking.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Mobile bottom nav fix verified via Playwright at 375x667. 12 items, widths 64-89px, scrollWidth 841 vs clientWidth 375. Coaches route works. Desktop lg:hidden confirmed hides bottom nav. All 12 sidebar routes present on desktop.
rca of the issue: Original bug: flex-1 + justify-around crammed 12 icons into 375px viewport making Coaches unreachable. Fix (overflow-x-auto on outer, min-w-max on inner flex, shrink-0 + min-w-[64px] per NavLink, plus .no-scrollbar utility in App.css) resolves it. Row now overflows horizontally beyond viewport and users can swipe/scroll to reach off-screen items.
